end.line: Quillon for Blackthorn IP’s licensing team

vo: Blackthorn I P drafts around four hundred licence agreements a year, and field-of-use clauses drift from deal to deal.
In Word, Quillon marks up each draft to your playbook and explains every change beside the clause.
Ask for a prior-art summary overnight, and every point comes back cited to the exact page.
Your positions are kept in one playbook, learned from thirty-eight closed matters and reviewed by a partner.
Mei will walk your team through it on Wednesday the eleventh.
